name: apiary
description: Browse, search and resume Claude Code sessions across folders and worktrees.
author: Nuwan Munasinghe <nuwanprabhath@gmail.com>

scripts.test:e2e: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.screenshot: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && playwright test --config=playwright.screenshot.config.ts
scripts.dist: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs x64
scripts.dist:mac:all: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
